primary_variables.matched_definition: Exposure to an exogenous small molecule, inhibitor, activator, toxicant, therapeutic compound, degrader, or vehicle that differentiates experimental groups.
evidence: SILAC light and heavy HEK293T and HeLa cells were subjected to vehicle or oxidative stress treatments (arsenic: 1 mM for 45 min; H2O2: 200 μM for 15 min).
As a control, we included a treatment condition that utilized emetine (50 nM, 2 h) as a method to dissolve RNA granules

primary_variables.matched_definition: Removal or limitation of glucose availability.
evidence: We also included glucose deprivation to compare nutrient and oxidative stress effects on SuTEx probe binding profiles
incubated with either DMEM or glucose free DMEM (Thermo Fisher Scientific, cat#11966025) supplemented 10% FBS and 1% l-glutamine

primary_variables.matched_definition: Comparison between wild-type and mutant or variant alleles, proteins, or genotypes.
evidence: Recombinant EDC3 wild-type (WT)- or tyrosine-475-to-phenylalanine (Y475F) mutant-expressing HEK293T cells
disruption of EDC3 tyrosine 475 (Y475) resulted in hypo-phosphorylation at S161 and S131

primary_variables.matched_definition: Genetic perturbation involving complete or partial loss of a gene or locus.
evidence: We utilized CRISPR-Cas9 to generate an EDC3 knockout (KO) HEK293T cell line
reinstatement of EDC3 WT or Y475F mutant can reverse the resulting phenotypes from absence of endogenous protein
incubated with either PBS or sodium (meta)arsenite (Sigma-Aldrich, cat#S7400; as a 1000x PBS stock; 1 mM final) in DMEM for 45 min
incubated with either water or hydrogen peroxide (200 μM in water as a 1000x stock, Macron, cat#MK5240120) in DMEM at 37 °C with 5% CO2 for 15 min
incubated with either DMEM or glucose free DMEM (Thermo Fisher Scientific, cat#11966025) supplemented 10% FBS and 1% l-glutamine, at 37 °C with 5% CO2 for 15 min
incubated with either water or emetine dihydrochloride (50 nM in water as a 1000x stock, Abcam, cat#ab141478) in DMEM at 37 °C with 5% CO2 for 2 h

replicate_hints: average of medians across multiple bioreplicates
multiplex_channel_hints: SILAC light and heavy HEK293T and HeLa cells

evidence: SILAC light and heavy HEK293T and HeLa cells were subjected to vehicle or oxidative stress treatments (arsenic: 1 mM for 45 min; H2O2: 200 μM for 15 min).
We mixed light and heavy samples to evaluate alterations in phosphorylation state of EDC3 Y475F mutant (L) compared with that of the WT (H) protein under arsenic treatment conditions.
reinstatement of EDC3 Y475F mutant (+Y475F) resulted in a statistically significant increase in the number of PBs per cell compared with mock KO cells under arsenic conditions

sample_scopes.detail: SuTEx probe-modified tyrosine and lysine enrichment via avidin-agarose beads
anti-FLAG immunoprecipitation of EDC3 and interactome

base_candidates_ranked.reason: Explicit use of SILAC (heavy/light) for quantification across multiple experiments (chemoproteomics, IP, and phosphoproteomics) using DDA (top-10 DDMS).

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: Specific use of TiO2 affinity chromatography for phosphopeptide enrichment.
Use of anti-FLAG beads for immunoprecipitation of EDC3 and its interactome.
Use of SuTEx probes and avidin-agarose beads for enrichment of modified tyrosine and lysine sites.
